english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical footstep or someone's manner of walking.

exampleSentences.english: Your tread is so heavy that the whole floor can hear you.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你行路咁大腳步，成層樓都聽到。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 haang4 lou6 gam3 daai6 goek3 bou6 sing4 cang4 lau4 dou1 teng1 dou3

english.note: Use 腳步 for an actual footstep or step taken while walking.

exampleSentences.english: I heard the pace of their footsteps as they approached.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我聽到佢行近嘅腳步聲。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 dou2 keoi5 haang4 gan6 ge3 goek3 bou6 seng1
